Subject: Internal: Nebula Health onboarding — canary policy draft & eval hooks

Jordan / Rishi — prepping for tomorrow’s kickoff. Draft items below (I’ll send a PDF to Emily/Phil after we sync):

Canary policy (draft v1):
- Canary window: first 48 hours after a model/param change or quantization update.
- Traffic split: 5% canary traffic to new variant, 95% baseline.
- Regression alert triggers:
  - Absolute drop: >6% decrease in accuracy on golden prompt set over a 1-hour moving window.
  - Latency spike: p95 increases >2x baseline for >15 minutes.
  - Safety failures: any single safety violation with PII leakage flagged as critical.
- Automatic rollback: enabled for Safety-critical violations or Latency critical (manual for accuracy drops).

Eval harness:
- We’ll wire Redwood eval hooks to their CI using our eval-runner (docker image) that can be triggered by PRs and deploy jobs.
- Need a stable prompt CSV and a mapping file of expected metric thresholds.

Checklist I’ll send to customer:
- Prioritization spreadsheet (top 12 prompts), sample responses (CSV).
- Access to audit log endpoints / sample logs.
- Contact for infra work (Phil).

Attachments: canary-policy-v1.pdf

—Marissa

Jordan / Marissa — thanks for the draft. A few clarifications from our side after the kickoff:

- For patient-facing prompts we want a conservative approach: start with 1% canary for the first 24 hours, then 3% for the next 24 hours before ramping. Non-patient flows can do 5%.
- We’ll attach a CSV of our sample prompt set (attached: nebula_sample_prompts.csv) — contains labels for safety/clinical-risk.
- For regression alerts:
  - Accuracy drop: alert at 4% over 30 minutes, but auto-rollback only if safety label failures occur.
  - We require an audit trail with signed events for any auto-rollback action (SOC2).

Phil will assist with network/VPC access; Marissa — we need your eval harness checklist and the short Ops-runbook for rollbacks before 11/18 so our infra team can validate firewall rules.

Emily

Attachments: nebula_sample_prompts.csv

1) Canary cadence: implement 1% -> 3% -> 5% for patient flows as described.
2) Eval harness work (owner: Rishi) — deliverable: integration checklist + Docker eval-runner image + sample CI steps by 11/18.
3) Ops rollback playbook (owner: Marissa) — short runbook with audit log references and DocuSign-approved rollback authority list by 11/18.
4) Regression alert thresholds: set alerts at 4% accuracy drop over 30m (informational) and safety label breach as critical (auto-rollback).
5) Infra: Phil to provide VPC egress rules and test endpoint by 11/16.
